values: Valuation date: 23 July 2026 • USD • IFRS • Primary method: FCFF DCF • Status: screen-grade, locally verified

Base fair value is approximately $23 per share, with a $13-$35 operating range. The market price is close to the bear case and implies roughly 11% annual TPV growth after 2026, versus the base fade from 35% to 15%. Confidence is moderate-low because monetization, emerging-market risk and normalized working capital dominate the result.

TPV growth must remain well above the reverse-DCF path; GP/TPV must stabilize near 0.8%; operating profit must compound faster than gross profit; corporate cash must remain separable from merchant settlement balances; regulatory and FX costs must not absorb operating leverage.
The market appears to discount a sharp post-2026 volume fade. The variant wedge is that merchant expansion and share-of-wallet gains can sustain faster TPV growth while unit economics stabilize.
Q2 2026 execution; 2H operating leverage; cross-border mix recovery; license expansion; disciplined use of the $300mm repurchase authorization.
Brazil tax, Argentina FX, Mexico tariffs, EM regulation, merchant concentration, processor receivable recoverability, take-rate compression, settlement-liquidity volatility and buyback execution.
